headline: Gold and silver rates steady today after a sharp fall over the past week
summary: Today's change in 24k gold is nil, with 22k and 18k also unchanged from yesterday, and silver is flat at ₹1,75,000 per kg. Over the last 7 days, 24k gold has dropped about 9.1% (from ₹13,762 to ₹12,508 per gram), and silver has fallen about 10.3% from ₹1,95,000 per kg. Over the 28 days covered by our history, gold is down about 12.4% and silver about 20.5% from their late-October levels, with gold's recent low set on 21 November. A stronger US dollar or rupee movements, along with softer festive and wedding demand, are possible contributors, though the note cannot confirm the cause.
outlook: Prices have been flat today, so if you are buying for a planned purchase, there is no urgency to act on a single day's figure, and it may help to compare making charges and GST across jewellers before paying.
